population_mapping: six equal-number stellar-mass bins in CAMELS; mapped by ordered population only and therefore treated as a prior, not a measured CF4 bias law
injection_rule: Use Gaussian/lognormal prior on physical radial FoG kernel width; do not identify it with NB count-dispersion k.
survival_status: ARES angular survival is still CF4-specific; CAMELS external prior does not calibrate survival.
production_gate: NO-GO until the prior is propagated through CF4 likelihood and an untouched CF4-disjoint holdout passes, with survival nuisance retained.
